description: The specified combined substitution satisfies \(\gamma(e(n))=\sigma(n)\) and \(\gamma(o(n))=\tau(n)\) for every \(n\), with any common residual variable alphabet.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.combine_even_odd.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  (σ τ : ℕ → L.Term α) (n : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.combine σ τ
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.even n) =
      σ n ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.combine σ τ
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.odd n) =
      τ n
